messages:
IncidentBot: [ALERT] GPU pool gc-pool-eu at 98% utilization. queue_length=11432, autoscaler attempted scale but hit region quota (current_quota=24, requested=6). p99 latency=12.3s. severity=high.
Sara: I'm on it. Paging oncall.
OncallML: oncall-ml here, taking lead. Confirm impacted model/version?
Dan: Deploybot shows rollout id 2819999000 -> redwood/v19-large-ctx. Noted sustained context growth: avg_seq_len 2300 -> 4300. KV-cache per session +2.1GB.
Maya: Pre-fill endpoints are the bulk of long prefixes. Can we throttle /api/v1/prefill or disable for lower tiers?
Eli: Proposed mitigations: 1) disable prefill for non-prod and public tier, 2) fallback to v19-small-quantized for public, 3) set KV eviction to aggressive LRU. Anyone see a major downside?
Sara: @CustomerSuccess please compile list of affected customers (top traffic) and start customer comms prep.
CustomerSuccess: ping. Initial top impacted customers: acme, oakpay, tutorly. We'll prepare alerts if latency >10s or errors >5%.
OncallML: I'll flip routing to prefer v18.2 for heavy bulk routes as immediate mitigation.
Dan: Applying route update now. Command run:
```bash
refctl route set --route /gen/bulk --prefer-model redwood/v18.2 --reason "mitigation 2825000000"
```
OpsBot: Route change accepted. 12 workers draining, 8 workers restarted with v18.2.
OncallML: Also lowering batch sizes and bumping kv eviction aggressiveness in runtime config, pushing patch.
```json
{
  "batch_max_tokens": 64,
  "kv_eviction": "aggressive",
  "prefill_enabled": false
}
```
Maya: Autoscaler logs still show failures: allocate request failed -> quota_exceeded. @Dan can cloud team grant emergency burst?
Dan: Sent emergency request. Cloud replied: can grant +4 GPUs for 2 hours. Not enough to cover queue.
Eli: Alternative: enable cross-region spill to us-west-2 pool (we have spare capacity), note added network latency. Should we enable fallback for enterprise tiers?
Sara: CS says some customers are US-based — cross-region might help them. Do we accept potential latency increase for improved throughput?
CustomerSuccess: ACME is US; cross-region would likely restore their performance. Oakpay mixed. We're ok with targeted fallback.
OncallML: Enabling cross-region fallback for enterprise only when local queue >5000. Applied policy now.
IncidentBot: action recorded action_id=act-2825-01. Observed p99 drop to 8.7s after route changes.
Maya: Looking into model diff — tokenizer changes in v19 may have inflated per-session KV keys/payload. Spotting a commit that pads special tokens and enables bidir-cache indices. That could double KV size.
Eli: Confirmed commit: tokenizer pad + bidir index. Reverting tokenizer patch should reduce per-session KV footprint. Suggest hotpatch revert of tokenizer to v18-compatible.
Dan: Rollback window? We can hotpatch model config without full redeploy; need QA signoff. ETA ~30m to finish canary run.
Sara: Proceed with tokenizer revert hotpatch. Plan: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%, monitor queue and kv footprints.
OncallML: Kicking off hotpatch now.
OpsBot: [hotpatch] canary start: v19-tokenizer-revert -> 10%
OpsBot: [hotpatch] success: canary at 10% healthy
OpsBot: [hotpatch] rolling to 50%
OncallML: After canary revert, per-session KV decreased ~45%. queue down from 11.4k -> 2.1k. p95 latency down to 3.2s.
Sara: Excellent. Keep elevated scale for 2h while we monitor and cloud team pursues quota increase.
Dan: Keeping support request open. If they can extend +4 GPUs beyond 2h we'll absorb spikes.
CustomerSuccess: Sending targeted notifications: ACME and Oakpay flagged impacted; service restored to acceptable latency. Will prepare post-incident comms.
Maya: Follow-up: add guardrail to rollout checks: alert on sudden increase in avg_seq_len or kv-per-session > 1.5x baseline during canary.
Eli: Also add an SLO for prefill-heavy routes to limit max prefix length or fail fast.
Sara: Agreed. Create postmortem and action items: eng-runtime to add KV footprint warning, eng-ml to revert tokenizer change in mainline until validated, eng-platform to add quota fallback playbook.
IncidentBot: Incident marked mitigated. duration=00:55:20. Tags: eng-runtime, eng-ml, eng-platform, product.
